questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Ideology?

options.text: It is a system of beliefs and values that a film can subtly reinforce or question.
It is the way a film constructs and portrays people, groups, and social realities.
It is a simplified, generalised image of a group that reduces individual complexity.
It is the dominance of one group's values accepted as common sense by society.

questions.explanation: It is a system of beliefs and values that a film can subtly reinforce or question. This is precisely what Ideology means; the alternatives describe Representation, Stereotype, Hegemony, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Ideology.
